auth.registration.title: Fungura konti yawe
auth.registration.subtitle:
Winjire muri AWA utangure
urugendo rwawe utuje.
auth.registration.hint: Nibura inyuguti 8, inyuguti nkuru, umubare n'ikimenyetso kidasanzwe
auth.forgotPassword.title: Wibagiye ijambo ry'ibanga?
auth.forgotPassword.subtitle:
Ntakibazo. Andika aderese yawe ya e-mail
tukuntumire ihuza ryo gushiraho irindi.
auth.forgotPassword.cardText: Tuzokutumira amabwiriza akenewe yo gushiraho irindi jambo ry'ibanga.
auth.forgotPassword.infoValidEmail: Aderese irakwiye. Gutuma ihuza bizoboneka igihe serivisi yo kwemeza uwinjira izoba iriho.
auth.forgotPassword.helpText: Vugana n'itsinda ryacu ry'infashanyo, turi hano kugufasha.
auth.forgotPassword.helpAlertMessage: Itsinda ryacu ry'infashanyo rizokugarukira vuba bishoboka.
anonymous.mode.activeSubtitle: Profile yawe iguma itaboshwe n'uwo uri we igihe ubu buryo bukora.
anonymous.mode.nothingKeptSubtitle: Aya makuru ntaboshwe kuri profile yawe itazwi.
anonymous.mode.appLockText: Ikode ya PIN canke biometrie igihe ufunguye AWA
anonymous.mode.disableText: Kugira usohoke mu buryo butazwi, urashobora gufungura konti ukayihuza n'aderese ya e-mail canke indangamuntu.
anonymous.mode.pitchSubtitle: Koresha ahawe muri AWA utaboshe uwo uri we kuri profile yawe.
anonymous.mode.identityPrivateTitle: Uwo uri we aguma ari ibanga
anonymous.mode.identityPrivateSubtitle: Amakuru yoshobora kukumenyesha ntakenewe mu gukoresha ubu buryo.
anonymous.mode.privacyRowAccount: Nta konti ya Google canke Apple ihujwe
anonymous.mode.infoText: Ibikorwa bimwebimwe vya konti, vyo guhuza canke vyo kugarura vyoshobora kugabanuka mu buryo butazwi.
anonymous.mode.recommendedProtectionText: Uzoshobora kurinda kwinjira muri AWA ukoresheje ikode yawe ya PIN canke biometrie.
anonymous.limitations.title: Imbere yo gukomeza
anonymous.limitations.subtitle: Mu buryo butazwi, ibikorwa bimwebimwe bijanye na konti bizogabanuka canke ntibizoboneka.
anonymous.limitations.recoveryText: Udafise aderese ya e-mail ihujwe, kugarura kwinjira muri konti yawe birashobora kugabanuka.
anonymous.limitations.syncText: Amakuru amwe ashobora kutaja ku zindi telefone zawe.
anonymous.limitations.communicationsText: AWA ntizoshobora kugutumira e-mail zijanye na konti yawe itazwi.
anonymous.limitations.securityText: Turagusavye gufungura ikode ya PIN canke biometrie kugira urinde kwinjira muri AWA.
anonymous.creating.creatingSubtitle: AWA iriko iratunganya ahawe hari ibanga, kandi iriko iratandukanya profile yawe n'amakuru yakumenyesha.
anonymous.creating.errorSubtitle: Hari ikitagenze neza. Urashobora kugerageza kandi.
anonymous.creating.protectionSubtitle: AWA iriko iratunganya ahawe ikurikije ibanga wahisemwo.
anonymous.creating.warning: Ntufunge porogaramu mu gihe ahawe haratunganywa.
anonymous.success.title: Uburyo butazwi bufunguye
anonymous.success.subtitle: Profile yawe ubu ntiboshwe n'uwo uri we. Koresha AWA ufise ibanga ryuzuye.
anonymous.success.cardSubtitle: Urashobora kuzimya uburyo butazwi igihe cose mu Ibanga n'umutekano.
anonymous.avatar.title: Rema avatar imeze nkawe
anonymous.avatar.subtitle: Hitamwo gusa ishusho n'ibara. Nta shusho yawe bwite ikenewe.
anonymous.avatar.styleSectionDescription: Uzoshobora kuyihindura inyuma muri profile yawe.
anonymous.avatar.infoTitle: Ibanga ryawe ni ryo rya mbere
anonymous.avatar.infoText: Iyi avatar isimbura ifoto yawe mu gihe uburyo butazwi bukora. Nta foto nyakuri ikoreshwa kuri profile yawe.
appLock.title: Ahawe harafunzwe
appLock.subtitle: Emeza uwo uri we kugira winjire ahawe bwite.
appLock.biometricAreaText: Koresha biometrie ifise umutekano ya telefone yawe kugira ufungure AWA.
appLock.biometricPromptSubtitle: Emeza uwo uri we kugira winjire ahawe.
pinSetup.confirmIdentitySubtitle: Andika PIN yawe y'ubu kugira uzimye irinda.

pinSetup.footerNote: PIN yawe iguma irinzwe mu bubiko bufise umutekano bwa telefone.
pinConfirm.title: Emeza PIN yawe
pinConfirm.subtitle: Yandike ubugira kabiri kugira wemeze.
pinManagement.title: Ikode ya PIN
faceIdSetup.noCapability: Nta buryo bwa biometrie bwateguwe kuri iyi telefone.

faceIdSetup.subtitleUnavailable: Nta buryo bwa biometrie bukoreshwa bwabonetse.
faceIdSetup.secureVerificationText: AWA ikoresha gusa idirisha rya biometrie rya telefone yawe. Nta makuru ya biometrie abikwa muri porogaramu.
faceIdSetup.footerHint: Urashobora kubizimya igihe cose mu igenamiterere.
privacySecurity.title: Ibanga n'Umutekano
privacySecurity.subtitle: Amakuru yawe, ibanga ryawe, ico wahisemwo 💜
privacySecurity.introText: Cunga ibanga ry'amakuru yawe, uhitemwo irinda rikubereye.
privacySecurity.discreetModeSubtitle: Hisha ibiri mu banga muri porogaramu
privacySecurity.discreetAppearanceSubtit: Izina n'ikimenyetso bya porogaramu ku rupapuro rwawe rw'itangiriro
privacySecurity.anonymousSubtitle: Koresha porogaramu utavuze uwo uri we
privacySecurity.dataManagementSubtitle: Raba, sohora canke usibe amakuru yawe
privacySecurity.footerInfo:
Igenamiterere ry'ibanga ryawe riguma mu maboko yawe.
Urashobora kurihindura igihe cose.
dataPrivacy.management.storageCount_one: Ububiko {{count}} bwo kuri telefone burakoreshwa ubu kuri iyi telefone.
dataPrivacy.management.storageCount_othe: Ububiko {{count}} bwo kuri telefone burakoreshwa ubu kuri iyi telefone.
dataPrivacy.management.exportDescription: Kora kopi ya JSON ukoresheje urutonde rwo gusangira rufise umutekano.
dataPrivacy.management.deletionInfoMessa: Kugira usibe vyose, koresha "Siba konti yanje" ku rupapuro rwabanje.
dataPrivacy.deleteAccount.warningText: Amakuru yose ya AWA abitswe kuri iyi telefone azosibwa burundu.
discreetLauncher.title: Isura y'ibanga
discreetLauncher.subtitle: Hitamwo ingene AWA igaragara ku rupapuro rwawe rw'itangiriro
discreetLauncher.infoCard: Ibi bihindura gusa izina n'ikimenyetso bya porogaramu ku rupapuro rwawe rw'itangiriro. Amakuru yawe n'irinda ryayo (ikode ya PIN, biometrie, ugufunga) biguma nk'uko biri, ukoresheje isura iyo ari yo yose uhisemwo.
discreetLauncher.androidOnly: Iki gikorwa kiboneka kuri Android gusa.
discreetLauncher.discreetDescription: Igaragara nka porogaramu isanzwe y'agenda, itavuga AWA
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendor: Iki gikorwa cagabanijwe na launcher ya telefone yawe.
discreetLauncher.noteDelay: Ikimenyetso gishasha gishobora gufata amasegonda make kugira kigaragare, bivanye na launcher yawe ya Android.
discreetLauncher.switchDiscreetBody: Porogaramu izogaragara ku izina “Agenda” n'ikimenyetso gisanzwe ku rupapuro rwawe rw'itangiriro. Amakuru yawe n'igenamiterere bizoguma nk'uko biri.
discreetLauncher.switchAwaBody: Porogaramu izosubira kugaragara ku izina n'ikimenyetso vya AWA.
discreetLauncher.errorModalBody: Ntivyashobotse guhindura isura ya porogaramu ubu. Isura yawe y'ubu ntiyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze inyuma.
discreetLauncher.unsupportedVendorModalB: Guhindura ikimenyetso ntibyemerewe kuri iyi telefone. Iki gikorwa cagabanijwe na launcher ya telefone yawe. Isura yawe y'ubu ntiyahindutse.
privateAccess.title: Ahantu h'ibanga
privateAccess.subtitle: Ahawe, ahawe gusa
privateAccess.privacyCardText: Amakuru yawe yose aguma aririnzwe kuri telefone yawe.
securitySetup.heroSubtitle: Hitamwo irinda ushaka gufungura. Urashobora guhindura iri genamiterere igihe cose.
securitySetup.statusNoneActive: Nta rindi rishingiye ku guhitamwo rifunguye
securitySetup.pinDescription: Funga AWA igihe ifunguwe ukoresheje ikode yawe bwite.
securitySetup.biometricsDescription: Koresha igikumu canke isura vya telefone yawe.
securitySetup.discreetNotificationsDescr: Hisha ivyo mu banga mu bigaragara bya notifications zawe.
securitySetup.infoText: Iri genamiterere ribikwa kugira ririnde ukoresha AWA, kandi rishobora guhindurwa inyuma.
privacyScreen.title:
Ibanga ryawe
ni ryo rya mbere
privacyScreen.subtitle:
Ugumana ubutegetsi bwuzuye ku makuru yawe.
Tuyarinda mu ntambwe zose.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noResaleDescrip: Amakuru yawe ntiyigera agurishwa, yimurirwa canke akoreshwa mu vy'ubucuruzi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.fullControlDesc: Uguma ugenga amakuru yawe n'ingene akoreshwa, igihe cose.
privacyScreen.guarantees.noExportDescrip: Amakuru yawe bwite ntiyigera asohorwa hanze ya serivisi.
privacyScreen.guarantees.encryptedDescri: Amakuru y'ibanga ararinzwe kandi amakuru yakumenyesha ntazwi.
privacyScreen.commitmentFullControl: Uguma ugenga amakuru yawe igihe cose.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoExport: Nta na rimwe mu makuru yawe bwite risohorwa.
privacyScreen.commitmentNoInternalAccess: Nta kwinjira kw'imbere kwemewe uretse mu bikorwa bikenewe cane kandi bifise umutekano.
privacyScreen.commitmentIdentityEncrypte: Amakuru yakumenyesha, nk'izina ryawe, arafunzwe kandi ntazwi.
privacyScreen.freedomText: Urashobora guhindura ivyo ukunda canke gusaba ko amakuru yawe asibwa igihe cose mu igenamiterere.
